text.offer: Well, now that you mention it, I do have this wand I picked up the other day, but I can't figure out what it does: it seems to repel magic. Could you take it to Frisconar, the apothecary in Tos, and have him identify it for me? I'd be most grateful if you could.
text.complete: Marvellous. It will certainly come in handy. Let me give you something for your trouble.

steps.brief: A wand, eh? Well, let me see here... ah ha! You see these runes along the handle? They say what it is. Allow me to put a label with the translation on the wand so that Pritchett will know.
